atAGlance: Bún đậu chay is a vegetarian take on the bún đậu platter: rice vermicelli, fried tofu, herbs, vegetables, and a vegetarian soy-lime or fermented-bean dip.
whatItIs: Bún đậu chay is the vegetarian version of bún đậu, usually with tofu, rice vermicelli, herbs, cucumber, and a vegetarian soy-lime or fermented-bean dip.
howToEnjoy: Build bites of tofu, bún, herbs, and cucumber, then dip lightly. Ask what the dip is made from if strict vegetarian eating matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order bún đậu chay and ask không nước mắm if the dip must be fully vegetarian. Request extra tofu or extra herbs before the platter arrives.
worthKnowing: The chay version keeps the platter rhythm of bún đậu while replacing meat and mắm tôm with vegetarian-friendly pieces.
goodToKnow: The standard non-vegetarian platter centers mắm tôm and pork. Chay should move it into tofu and a vegetarian mắm-style dip.
travelerCaution: Confirm the vegetarian mắm-style dip is truly vegetarian if strict.
